lead.en: Reveal details on a photo with a glass panel and a pointer-following highlight.
lead.zh: 用带指针高光的玻璃面板，在照片上展开简短详情。

rule.en: Tap the photo or press Enter or Space on the header. Tab reaches the detail actions. Escape returns focus to the header.
rule.zh: 点照片或在标题上按 Enter、空格展开。Tab 可进入详情操作，Esc 收起并返回标题。

api.en: Supply an image, alt text and title with optional subtitle, trailing and detail slots. The tilt defaults to 6°. Set with_open to have the host manage expansion.
api.zh: 提供图片、替代文本和标题，可附加副标题、右侧内容及详情。默认倾斜 6°，with_open 可交给宿主管理展开。

motion.en: The glass panel grows upward with a spring while the photo zooms to 1.05×. Reduced motion keeps the detail fade and snaps the layout.
motion.zh: 玻璃面板沿底边向上弹性展开，照片同步放大至 1.05 倍。减少动效时直接切换布局，保留文字淡入。

lead.en: Float a draggable glass lens above scrolling content, with a separate action bubble.
lead.zh: 在滚动内容上浮动显示可拖动的玻璃镜片和独立操作圆钮。

rule.en: Tap or drag between tabs. Arrow keys include the action in their wrap order. Scroll down to compact and up to expand.
rule.zh: 点按或拖动切换标签。方向键循环包含独立操作。下滚收起，上滚展开。

api.en: Supply stable item values, icons and optional badges. The action is optional. Value and compact state can be controlled independently.
api.zh: 提供稳定标识、图标和可选徽标。独立操作可省略，选中值和收起状态可以分别受控。

motion.en: The lens lifts and stretches with speed. One spring keeps the lens aligned while the bar and labels change size. Reduced motion switches the geometry immediately.
motion.zh: 镜片随速度抬升和伸展。栏位和标签缩放时，镜片由同一布局进度定位。减少动效时直接切换。

lead.en: Grow one floating button into a quick action menu and draft-preserving composer.
lead.zh: 让一个浮动按钮展开动作菜单和表单，保留每个动作的独立草稿。

rule.en: Open a task, note, or reminder. Arrow keys and letter shortcuts navigate the menu. Escape goes back one step.
rule.zh: 打开任务、便笺或提醒。可用方向键和字母快捷键操作，Esc 返回上一步。

api.en: Each action supplies its own composer and optional choices. Deferred saves resolve by ticket and keep the draft on failure.
api.zh: 每项动作配置独立表单和可选选项。延迟保存按编号回传结果，失败保留草稿。

motion.en: The surface grows from a fixed bottom corner. The composer slides in and folds back to a drawn check on success.
motion.zh: 面板从固定底角长出，表单滑入，保存成功后折回并绘出勾选标记。

lead.en: Fan a stack of payment cards and lift one to see its balance and recent activity.
lead.zh: 展开成叠的支付卡片，抽出一张查看余额与近期交易。

rule.en: Hover to fan. Drag down or up to browse. Open a card to view its balance and activity, or press Esc to put it back.
rule.zh: 悬停展开卡片。上下拖动浏览。打开卡片查看余额与交易，按 Esc 收回。

when: Show balances and activity for a small set of cards, passes or memberships.
en.apiLead: The entity owns selection and accepts cards with masked suffixes, materials, balances and activity.

props.name: new
props.description: Supply cards in stack order. The first card starts in front.

props.name: with_id
props.description: Set a stable root element ID.

props.name: with_label
props.description: Set the visible heading and accessible group name.

props.name: with_currency
props.description: Use this ISO currency code for balances and transactions.

props.name: with_locale
props.description: Select separators and the currency format.

props.name: with_amount_formatter
props.description: Format an amount using currency and locale.

props.name: with_style
props.description: Refine the root GPUI layout.

props.name: front_card
props.description: Read the front card whether open or closed.

props.name: selected_card
props.description: Read the open card.

props.name: set_device_light
props.description: Set normalized light axes or return to pointer control.

props.name: WalletStackSelected
props.description: Reports the opened card or no selection when closed.

props.name: WalletStackCard::with_variant
props.description: Choose Metal, Black, Glass or Color.

props.name: WalletStackCard::with_network
props.description: Show the fictional mark, hide it, or supply a label or SVG.

props.name: WalletStackCard::with_transactions
props.description: The first three transactions appear in order. A transaction avatar takes priority over its glyph.

motion: Direct manipulation and spring motion share one stack position. In the open state the selected card scales to 88%.
Balance counts up after the card moves, and the first three transactions reveal in order. Reduced motion applies the final geometry immediately.
ai: Pass only card suffixes and use stable IDs.
not: For generic swipeable content, use Card stack. For many accounts, use a list or data grid.

when: 为少量支付卡、通行证或会员卡显示余额与交易。
zh.apiLead: 由实体管理选中状态，卡片可配置尾号、材质、余额和交易。

props.name: new
props.description: 传入按顺序排列的卡片。初始显示第一张。

props.name: with_id
props.description: 设置稳定的根元素标识。

props.name: with_label
props.description: 设置标题和无障碍分组名称。

props.name: with_currency
props.description: 余额和交易使用此 ISO 货币代码。

props.name: with_locale
props.description: 选择数字分隔符和货币格式。

props.name: with_amount_formatter
props.description: 按货币和地区格式化金额。

props.name: with_style
props.description: 调整 GPUI 根布局。

props.name: front_card
props.description: 读取当前位于最前的卡片。

props.name: selected_card
props.description: 读取已经展开的卡片。

props.name: set_device_light
props.description: 设置归一化光照轴，传入空值恢复鼠标控制。

props.name: WalletStackSelected
props.description: 报告展开的卡片，收起时报告空值。

props.name: WalletStackCard::with_variant
props.description: 选择 Metal、Black、Glass 或 Color。

props.name: WalletStackCard::with_network
props.description: 可使用虚构标记、隐藏、传入文案或 SVG。

props.name: WalletStackCard::with_transactions
props.description: 按顺序展示前三笔交易。头像优先于图标。

motion: 直接拖动和弹簧使用同一组位置。展开时选中卡片缩到 88%。
卡片移动后余额递增，前三笔交易依次显现。减少动效时直接应用最终位置。
ai: 只传卡片尾号，并使用稳定标识。
not: 普通滑动内容用 Card stack。大量账户用列表或数据表格。

lead.en: Open workspace controls for focus, notifications, presenting, volume and text size.
lead.zh: 在一块面板中管理专注、通知、演示、音量和字号。

rule.en: Open a tile’s detail with its chevron. Drag the meters or use the arrow and page keys. Esc closes detail and returns focus.
rule.zh: 点箭头展开设置详情。可拖动滑轨，或使用方向键和翻页键。Esc 关闭详情并恢复焦点。

when: Provide a compact group of workspace settings and focus presets.
not: Use regular switches or sliders for an ordinary form.
en.apiLead: The control owns settings. Hosts receive full snapshots to persist and apply their preferences.

props.name: new
props.description: Supply stable preset and channel IDs.

props.name: with_id
props.description: Identify the panel in the GPUI tree.

props.name: with_people
props.description: Names and image sources for people allowed to reach a focused user.

props.name: with_default_volume
props.description: Alert volume from 0 to 100, in steps of 1.

props.name: with_default_text_size
props.description: Text size from 85 to 130, in steps of 5.

props.name: with_format_time
props.description: Format a draft or committed session end time.

props.name: with_label
props.description: Accessible name of the group.

props.name: with_style
props.description: Refine the outer GPUI layout.

props.name: state
props.default: Focus off, notifications on, presenting off
props.description: Read the entire settings snapshot.

props.name: ControlCenterChanged
props.description: Reports a committed change or a distinct meter step.

motion: Details expand from the originating tile. Meters follow the pointer from the original value and return from resisted edges.
The dial continues through twelve o’clock and settles at five-minute increments. Reduced motion snaps geometry and keeps opacity changes.
ai: Apply focus and notification rules in your application.

when: 在紧凑面板中提供工作区设置和专注预设。
not: 常规表单使用普通开关或滑轨。
zh.apiLead: 控件管理设置，宿主接收完整快照并保存或应用对应偏好。

props.name: new
props.description: 传入具有稳定标识的专注预设和通知频道。

props.name: with_id
props.description: 指定 GPUI 树中的面板标识。

props.name: with_people
props.description: 可在专注期间联系用户的人员姓名和头像来源。

props.name: with_default_volume
props.description: 提示音量 0–100，步进 1。

props.name: with_default_text_size
props.description: 文字大小 85–130，步进 5。

props.name: with_format_time
props.description: 格式化草稿和已提交会话的结束时间。

props.name: with_label
props.description: 无障碍分组名称。

props.name: with_style
props.description: 调整外层 GPUI 布局。

props.name: state
props.default: 关闭专注、开启通知、关闭演示
props.description: 读取完整设置快照。

props.name: ControlCenterChanged
props.description: 报告已提交的变化或不同的滑轨档位。

motion: 详情从对应卡片展开。滑轨从原值跟随拖动，越界时产生阻尼并回弹。
拨盘跨过十二点继续累计，松手后吸附到 5 分钟档。减少动效时直接切换几何位置，保留淡入淡出。
ai: 在宿主应用中应用专注和通知规则。

lead.en: Open a story card as a full article and pull it back into the grid.
lead.zh: 将故事卡片展开为文章，下拉即可收回原位。

rule.en: Click a card, or use Enter or Space. Escape closes and restores focus. Scroll to read, or pull down from the top to dismiss.
rule.zh: 点击卡片或按 Enter、空格打开。Escape 关闭并恢复焦点。滚动阅读，在顶部下拉关闭。

api.en: Provide an image, alternate text and a GPUI article body for each stable ID. Use controlled or default selection, a 4:3 hero, and a customizable close label.
api.zh: 为稳定 ID 提供图片、替代文本和 GPUI 正文。支持受控或默认打开项，封面默认 4:3，关闭名称可配置。

motion.en: The shared hero and title expand to the sheet and close into the measured slot. A short pull returns without dismissing.
motion.zh: 封面与标题共同展开，关闭时回到实测卡位。短距离下拉会复位。

lead.en: Tilt a membership card under moving foil and flip to its reverse.
lead.zh: 倾斜会员卡时带动箔面与反光，点按即可翻到背面。

rule.en: Move the pointer to tilt. Click or press Enter or Space to flip. Drag a finger when device tilt is unavailable.
rule.zh: 移动鼠标可倾斜卡片。点击或按 Enter、空格翻面。设备倾斜不可用时可用手指拖动。

api.en: Supply a front and optional reverse. Default width is 300px at 5:7, tilt is 14° and intensity is 1. Use with_flipped to control the side and set_device_tilt to provide host orientation.
api.zh: 传入正面及可选背面。默认宽 300px，比例为 5:7，倾斜 14°，反光强度为 1。用 with_flipped 管理翻面状态，用 set_device_tilt 接入宿主方向数据。

motion.en: A spring rotates the card by half a turn, preserving velocity on reversal. The glare trails the tilt. Reduced motion crossfades painted faces.
motion.zh: 翻面沿弹簧旋转半圈，中途反向保留当前速度。反光稍后跟上倾斜。减少动效时使用正反面淡入淡出。
